additional_sources.protocol: Official ARC Prize GPT-6 Luna results page, published 2026-09-22, carrying an ARC Prize Verified badge. Its summary identifies 86.7% on ARC-AGI-1/v1 and 59.3% on ARC-AGI-2/v2 as the model's best Semi-Private scores; the table lists per-variant ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2 percentages. Basis is the evaluator-published benchmark result; source reasoning labels are retained.
